question: The famous slogan "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it " was given by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The famous slogan "**Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it**" was given by **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, a prominent leader in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• This slogan became a rallying cry for the Indian independence movement and inspired millions of Indians to fight against British colonial rule.
 
• Tilak, often referred to as the "**Father of Indian Unrest**," was one of the first leaders to demand full independence for India.
 
• The slogan was used by Tilak in the context of his speeches and writings, particularly during the **Home Rule Movement** of 1916-1918, which aimed at achieving self-governance for India within the British Empire.
 
• Tilak's emphasis on Swaraj (self-rule) was instrumental in uniting people across the country against the British colonial government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Bal Gangadhar Tilak:**

 
 
• Tilak was born on **23 July 1856** in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra, and is considered one of the most influential leaders of the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was a scholar, nationalist, and social reformer who advocated for Swaraj as a fundamental right of Indians.
 
• Tilak was also a prolific writer and edited newspapers such as **Kesari** (Marathi) and **The Mahratta** (English), which became platforms for expressing nationalist sentiments.
 
 
 
• **Home Rule Movement:**
 
 
• Started in 1916, the **Home Rule Movement** was led by Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant to demand self-governance for India.
 
• Tilak’s leadership and his slogan energized the masses, making the movement a significant step towards India's independence.
 
 
 
• **Other Contributions of Tilak:**
 
 
• Tilak popularized the celebration of **Ganesh Chaturthi** and **Shivaji Jayanti** to promote unity among Indians.
 
• He authored books like "**Gita Rahasya**," which reflected his interpretation of the Bhagavad Gita as a call for action.
 
 
 
• **Other Key Leaders and Their Contributions:**
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi:** Known for his philosophy of non-violence and movements like Civil Disobedience and Quit India.
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose:** Advocated armed struggle for independence and founded the Indian National Army (INA).
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji:** Known as the "Grand Old Man of India," he highlighted economic exploitation under British rule through the **Drain Theory**.
